'''Gramophone Dev''' is a small music wiki for trying out the [[Special:Version#mw-version-ext-parserhook-Gramophone|Gramophone]] extension. Its pages use the extension the way a fan wiki would: an album with its track list, a song with lyrics, an artist page and a page of previews. One more page is written with the old Sm2Shim tags, to show that old wikitext still works.

== Pages ==
* [[Galaxy Triangle]], an album by La prière: the whole album as a playlist, a track list with play buttons and a table of previews
* [[Bubblin']], a song by HIMEHINA: the lyrics panel, with the lyrics file on the wiki and on another site
* [[VALIS]], the artist of Mukyu Platonic: a player in an infobox, a play button in a sentence and a player with a cover
* [[Previews]]: play buttons only, for files on a mirror, on a site without CORS and behind Special:FilePath
* [[Sm2Shim compatibility]]: the old tags <code>&lt;flashmp3&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;sm2&gt;</code>, <code>&lt;modernsoundmanager&gt;</code> and <code>&lt;ab&gt;</code>

Files: [[Special:ListFiles]]. Other skins: [{{fullurl:Galaxy Triangle|useskin=vector-2022}} Vector 2022], [{{fullurl:Galaxy Triangle|useskin=timeless}} Timeless], [{{fullurl:Galaxy Triangle|useformat=mobile}} phone with Citizen], [{{fullurl:Galaxy Triangle|useformat=mobile&useskin=minerva}} phone with Minerva].

The lyrics file [[:File:Bubblin.lrc|Bubblin.lrc]] holds lines written for this wiki that explain the lyrics panel. They are not the song's lyrics.
